inputs.doc: E-028 EVAL wave 5: rolled corridor AUC for the xl tier — e028xl55 seeds 0-2 (1024x16, 205.4M, weights-only heads published from #308-#310 after the 2GiB backup work) against the e017 gate. THE question after #304: capacity transfers to the roll at 768x12 (+0.05 AUC paired); does the trend continue at 205M, where the forecast ratio (0.129-0.133) is the project best?
